## Purpose

Describe the user problem and the result of this change.

## Technical Basis

List formulas, primary technical or regulatory sources, assumptions, units, applicability boundaries, and model-version changes. Write “Not applicable” for changes with no calculation impact.

## Verification

List the commands and manual checks performed.

- [ ] Unit or reference tests cover new calculations and boundaries.
- [ ] Browser behavior was checked at desktop and narrow-mobile widths.
- [ ] Keyboard access, visible focus, labels, and touch targets were preserved.
- [ ] RF-exposure wording does not imply certification or demonstrated compliance.
- [ ] Public files contain no credentials, private station data, or machine-specific paths.
- [ ] Documentation and screenshots were updated when visible behavior changed.

## Visible Changes

Include screenshots for interface changes and describe any migration or saved-data impact.
